issues.body:
`_step_version` scans the whole step block for any stripped line beginning `version:` without checking its YAML parent. A workflow step can therefore omit `with.version` (so wasm-pack-action uses its default) yet contain a valid unrelated key such as `env:
  version: v0.15.0`; `_step_version` returns `v0.15.0`, the exact-version check passes, and the repo-wide equality check can also pass. The mutation guard covers deletion only when no other same-named key exists, so it does not prove the documented property that every action explicitly receives a version input.
issues.fix_hint: Parse `version:` only as a direct child of the step's `with:` mapping, using indentation-aware logic like the existing `_has_with_tool` helper. Add a synthetic mutation with no `with.version` but an unrelated nested `version: v0.15.0` (for example under `env:`) and assert it is rejected. Also reject duplicate direct `with.version` entries.
issues.title: Version detection does not require the action's with.version input

verdict.summary:
Round 2 fixes the exact omitted-line mutation from round 1 and the focused suite passes, but the asserted invariant is still not fully enforced: `_step_version` accepts any `version:` key anywhere in the action step rather than requiring it to be the action's `with.version` input. A valid step with `env:
  version: v0.15.0` and no `with.version` is still unpinned while all new checks pass. Because one major test-validity finding remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
